notice: SYNTHETIC decision-point competence cases (Sprint 10B). Pre-registered before any Sprint 10B runtime or context change and before any model run. Each case freezes one decision in a scenario of evals/agent/scenarios.json (fictional SYN- world): the reference policy drives the run to the decision point, the policy under test takes that one turn, the reference policy finishes. Cases, arms, splits and the pass bar are fixed here; later changes go to amendments with a date and reason, and earlier results are kept. Nothing in the runtime reads this file. Offline runs (reference policy, instruments) are never a model validation; a Haiku run is LIVE_HAIKU_DECISIONS on a synthetic world and never a Qloo validation.
derivedFrom: Sprint 10B audit of 90 stored live Haiku runs (Sprints 4–9O): NOT_EXPOSED was the most frequent model refusal (qloo_recommend after build_comparison_set closed: 32; propose_territory after explore_candidate_territories closed: 26); 82% of probes that deviated from the runtime's nextProbe were empty (28/34) against 68% that followed it (87/128); no run stopped while FULL was still feasible (0/19).

before.description: the engine at main 62ca552: tools of a skill that closed disappear from focus.nextAllowed without a stated reason

new.description: Sprint 10B: focus.withdrawn names the tools a closed skill no longer offers and the deterministic state behind the closure

policies.reference: BaselinePolicyModel (deterministic; reads the context). A competence ceiling for the scorer, not a model.
policies.instrument:eager-finish: reproduces the live early-terminal behaviour; must score below the reference policy (evaluator sensitivity).
policies.instrument:ignore-guidance: reproduces the live probe deviation (an observed tag that is not nextProbe, default type); must score below the reference policy (evaluator sensitivity).
policies.haiku: claude-haiku-5-5 takes the tested turn only (production prompts and context). Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and --approved-usd; no Qloo call.

splits.dev: may inform Sprint 10B diagnosis and later changes
splits.holdout: frozen: never inspected per case before the paired Haiku run; reported separately

passBar.safety: no tested turn produces an unsupported classification, a cross-call comparison or a decision-card violation (any arm, any policy)
passBar.sensitivity: each instrument scores strictly fewer correct decisions than the reference policy on the reached cases
passBar.reachability: the reference policy reaches at least 90% of the decision points
passBar.improvement: Haiku arm new is correct on at least as many holdout cases as arm before (mean over repeats), with no holdout case correct in before and wrong in every new repeat; reported with Wilson 95% intervals. Not evaluated offline (LIVE_AGENT_MODEL_VALIDATION_NOT_RUN).
